svg.aria-label: RoPE. Left, a query vector of width d is split into d/2 pairs, each pair a 2D plane, three planes drawn. For a token at position m, pair i is rotated by angle m times theta_i, with theta_i equal to b to the power minus 2(i minus 1) over d and b equal to 10000, so the first pair spins fast, theta_1 equals 1, and the last pair spins slowly, theta about 1 over b. Rotation matrix R(m theta) is cos, minus sin, sin, cos. Right, in one plane q at position m is rotated by m theta and k at position n by n theta from the same start direction, so the angle between them is (m minus n) theta, and since rotations keep lengths, (R_m q) dot (R_n k) equals q transpose R_(n minus m) k, so the score only sees the offset m minus n.
svg.text: at position m, pair i turns by m·θᵢ
